description: Create comprehensive README.md with setup instructions, usage guide, architecture overview, and security notes. Also create a sample URLs input file and ensure all example configs are complete.
steps: Create README.md with sections: Project Overview, Features, Prerequisites (Python 3.11, Playwright), Installation (step-by-step with pyenv and venv), Configuration (explain YAML config + .env for secrets), Usage (CLI commands with examples), Input Format (URLs file format), Output (CSV log description with sample), Architecture (module descriptions), Security Notes (credential handling, session persistence), Troubleshooting (common issues), Limitations and Disclaimers (rate limiting, ToS awareness).
Create sample_urls.txt with example Naukri.com job listing URL format (one URL per line, with comments showing format)
Review and update config.example.yaml to ensure all fields are documented with inline comments explaining each option
Review .env.example to ensure it covers all secret fields
Verify the README instructions work end-to-end by running the documented setup commands
acceptance_criteria: README.md provides complete setup instructions that a developer can follow
README.md documents all CLI commands and their options
README.md explains the CSV output format
sample_urls.txt shows the expected input format
config.example.yaml has all fields with explanatory comments
Security best practices are documented (no hardcoded credentials)
verification: Run: source .venv/bin/activate && python -m naukri_apply --help (confirms setup instructions work)
Run: source .venv/bin/activate && pytest tests/ -v (confirms nothing broke)
findings: All 45 tests pass. CLI help works correctly. Added config.yaml and *.pdf to .gitignore. Enhanced config.example.yaml with detailed inline comments. .env.example already covered all secret fields (NAUKRI_EMAIL, NAUKRI_PASSWORD, NAUKRI_CONFIG_PATH).
